annotations.exact_quote: Multi-Instance Multi-Label learning (MIML) deals with data objects that are represented by a bag of instances and associated with a set of class labels simultaneously.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确研究多实例多标记学习，对象同时关联多个类别标记，属于多标记学习任务。

annotations.exact_quote: users usually tag only a part of positive labels, and the untagged labels are not necessarily negative.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要将弱标记定义为只标注部分正标记、未标注标记未必为负，属于不完整监督并作为核心研究问题。

annotations.exact_quote: highly relevant labels share some common in-stances
annotations.reason_zh: 方法假设高度相关标签共享部分实例，显式利用标签间相关性来建模，满足标签相关性建模定义。
